subject: Mathematics
title: Condition Numbers and Numerical Stability
description: This set of notes introduces IEEE floating point arithmetic, numerical stability, condition numbers, error amplification, and reliable methods for solving systems of equations.
objectives: Describe IEEE binary32 and binary64 floating point formats
Explain rounding, overflow, underflow, signed zero, infinity, and NaN
Recognize how repeated operations and different groupings can change computed results
Calculate and interpret condition numbers for numerical problems
Distinguish conditioning, forward error, backward error, and numerical stability
Evaluate the reliability of a computed solution using residuals and condition estimates
prerequisites: Basic understanding of systems of linear equations
Familiarity with matrix multiplication and matrix inverses
